commit_message: Fix ACP startup formatting and Goose runtime import
pr_title: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- keep ACP provider discovery, process launch, Managed Local endpoint startup, initialization, and session negotiation off the egui presentation thread
- apply the exact rustfmt shape reported by Windows Validation
- restore the Goose runtime type import still required by Benchmark Campaign discovery and Managed Local setup checks without restoring synchronous AI Studio startup

This follows the core non-blocking ACP startup commit and preserves current ACP MCP permission identity.
